title: Delivery Fee Refund Terms by Method: Delivery & Pickup Appointments
content:
Whether the delivery fee on a Delivery & Pickup Appointment comes back to the buyer depends on the fulfillment method. Billing applies the switches below, one row per method.

| Fulfillment method | Delivery fee refunded when the vehicle is returned under the 7-day return | Paid delivery fee refunded when the order is cancelled before handover | Delivery fee refunded when the buyer refuses at handover for a reason not on the accepted refusal list | Business days to return a refunded delivery fee to the original card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | Yes | Yes | Yes | 5 |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | Yes | Yes | Yes | 5 |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | Yes | Yes | Yes | 5 |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | Yes | Yes | Yes | 5 |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | No | Yes | No | 5 |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | No | Yes | No | 5 |

"Yes" means the delivery fee is refunded in that situation. "No" means it is not.

### Reading the table

- Every method refunds a paid delivery fee when the order is cancelled before handover.
- Only Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery and Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery keep the delivery fee on a 7-day return and on a refusal for a reason not on the accepted list. The other four methods refund it in both situations.
- Every method returns a refunded delivery fee to the original card within 5 business days.
